name: Morogoro

queries.query: Morogoro Tanzania official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS Ministry of Lands
queries.result: Official Ministry of Lands e-Ardhi and GeoServer sources were found. The public GeoServer WFS advertises cadastral/spatial-unit layers; a bounded anonymous geometry request at the WUP point timed out.

queries.query: Morogoro Manispaa huduma ardhi ramani kadastri kiwanja daftari ardhi
queries.result: Official Ministry and Morogoro Municipal sources confirm local land surveying, mapping, title and land-service activity. The e-Ardhi site requires an account for service applications; no login or form submission was used.

registryBasis: A first-party Ministry of Lands e-Ardhi deployment exposes the public taspro GeoServer WFS. GetCapabilities and DescribeFeatureType were retrieved anonymously. The spatial_units layer schema exposes safe native id, uid and geometry fields, while also advertising many restricted attributes that were not requested. This evidences an official cadastral/spatial-unit map service, not a verified parcel at the city point.

requests.outcome: HTTP page retrieved; public e-Ardhi service description reviewed. It states that applications require an account.
Retrieved WFS capabilities. Layers included taspro:spatial_units, taspro:survey_spatial_units, taspro:tp_spatial_units, and related administrative/map layers.
Retrieved schema. Safe candidate fields were id, uid and geom; owner, contact, address and other unsafe fields were not requested.
Timed out after 30 seconds with no response; no geometry retained. This is not evidence of citywide absence.
Timed out after 20 seconds with no response; no geometry retained. Exact WUP point was not shifted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The official e-Ardhi GeoServer publishes national land-management map layers; the reviewed capabilities do not by themselves establish complete Morogoro city coverage.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official WFS capabilities and spatial_units schema verified; no bounded feature response verified.

technicalBlocker: Anonymous WFS GetFeature requests for a bounded area and a tiny exact-point box timed out. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA or TLS bypass was used.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the public WFS will return geometry under a longer service-side response window or through another bounded layer/query; whether Morogoro citywide parcel coverage is complete.
pointBasis: Exact WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement point; not shifted to force a parcel hit.
